test_description: Verify 'Last Write Wins' conflict resolution during offline-to-online transition
business_risk: Critical - Data corruption leads to user trust loss
preconditions: User logged in; Device offline; Local Isar DB populated; Backend record exists
test_steps: 1. Modify Record A locally (Offline); 2. Simulate server-side modification of Record A (newer timestamp); 3. Restore network; 4. Trigger Sync Worker
expected_result: Local modification is overwritten by server state based on timestamp; Conflict logged
test_data_needs: Pre-seeded user account; Network Link Conditioner profile
tools_required: Flutter Integration Test; Mock Web Server; Isar Inspector
dependencies: Sync Worker; Isar DB; Backend API
success_criteria: 100% data consistency after sync; No crash; UI updates to reflect server state
failure_impact: High - User sees stale or incorrect data
cleanup_requirements: Reset local DB; Restore server state
performance_expectations: Sync resolves within 5 seconds of reconnection

test_description: Validate Idempotent Processing of Apple App Store Webhooks
business_risk: Critical - Revenue loss or double provisioning
preconditions: Webhook endpoint exposed; Valid Apple signature key available
test_steps: 1. Send valid subscription_renewed webhook; 2. Verify User Role = Premium; 3. Resend exact same webhook payload; 4. Verify no side-effects/errors
expected_result: First request returns 200 OK and updates DB; Second request returns 200 OK and performs no update (Idempotent)
success_criteria: Role updated correctly; Audit log contains exactly one entry per unique event

test_description: Verify cascading hard-delete of PII and immutable audit logging
preconditions: User has data in Library, Sessions, Goals, and OpenSearch index
test_steps: 1. Initiate Delete Account; 2. Verify User record gone from Aurora; 3. Verify Vectors gone from OpenSearch; 4. Verify 'UserDeleted' event in S3 Audit Log
expected_result: PII removed from operational stores; Audit log persists indefinitely
dependencies: Account Deletion Orchestrator; S3 Object Lock
success_criteria: Zero PII remaining; Audit log present and locked
